name: computer-agent
description: Control local Docker or remote Tailscale @cloudflare/computer instances with persistent SQLite VFS, Git, shell execution, and X11 GUI desktop automation via MCP tools or the standalone computer-cli.

suggestedPrompts.title: Inspect Cloud Desktop Status
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Check the active computerd connection status and take a screenshot of the X11 desktop.

suggestedPrompts.title: Discover Tailscale Computers
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Scan my Tailscale Tailnet for online computerd nodes and connect to the remote desktop.

suggestedPrompts.title: Open URL in Cloud Browser
suggestedPrompts.prompt: Open Chromium on the cloud desktop, navigate to https://live.48.cn/Index/main/club/1, and capture a screenshot.
